batch_node.name: zizmor collector schedule
batch_node.description: Seeds the tap_cares schedule that fires zizmor:zizmor on its own cadence, independent of github_core's collection. See req-zizmor-trigger in specs/spec-zizmor-v0.md.

data.cost_per_fire: No API calls and no credential: the collector reads workflow rows already on the grid and runs a local binary. One fire costs a subprocess per workflow with raw_yaml (~41 ms each; ~3 s for the 77 observed on a real organisation), so the cadence is chosen for freshness, not for a quota.

node.name: zizmor audit
node.description: Re-audits every workflow on the grid with the pinned zizmor binary, offline. Owned by this plugin rather than by a consumer because the finding set is a property of the scanner and its pin, not of any one product's page: a zizmor bump changes what is true here even if no workflow changed. Runs at :23 past, four times a day - off the hour so it does not pile onto the top-of-hour scheduler tick alongside every other cadence. A fire that finds a github_core collection still running finalizes as skipped and creates no run node, because a run that read rows mid-write would report a coverage number it cannot stand behind. Disable or re-time this freely; Schedule is user-editable.
